plain.li: A stranger knew my name today. Not from a wanted poster, for once. From something I did right.
{X_nameDef} thanked me for something I'd half forgotten. I've been thinking about it all evening. You never know what stays with people.
I don't know what to do with being thanked like that. I said it was nothing. It wasn't nothing to them.
[trait:Kind] There are people out there who think of this colony and think of me. That's a strange and good thing to carry about.
[skill:Medicine] Saw my own stitches today on a stranger's arm, healed clean. Best thing I've seen all season.
[trait:Abrasive] Got thanked by a stranger and didn't know where to look. Told them to stop it. Didn't mean it.
[child] A grown-up from far away said my name like it was important. I'm going to remember it forever.
